proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ X
  by_contra hne
  simp only [not_exists, not_le] at hne
  have h : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hlt : ∑ ω, X ω < ∑ _ω : Ω, (∑ ω', X ω') / Fintype.card Ω :=
    Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty Finset.univ_nonempty (fun ω _ => hne ω)
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ h.ne'] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (X : Ω → ℝ), ∃ ω, (∑ ω', X ω') / Fintype.card Ω ≤ X ω
